title: Changed source access is a real prerequisite
statement: Inherited contraction survives increased rates with sufficient fixed cycle,but new centers/guides/projector/full paths are separately acquired. M29three-spin example uses exponential8state acquisition,a~5.82e-13prefix with~.928acceptance and interval enclosures. M2stress lies outside uniform grid prescription and has separate selected-prefix certificate:proposal~.94179 versus corrected continuum~.97854. Corrected finite-word joint-TV cumulative count leaves reported confidence lowerbounds>95%,without resampling. Direct interval computation wins. Old marginal mixed-accuracy shortcuts fail:shared Bernoulli randomness can give linear-error variance,black-box hierarchy can force expensive exponent. These are interface failures,not Hamiltonian hardness. Continuous-time QMC is established prior. No raw program replay or generic retained-source execution.
